meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 集成 Matrix 聊天频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Matrix 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Matrix chat channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Matrix chat to your application

howto.what: 这个技能为 Claude 添加 Matrix 聊天渠道支持。它会复制 Matrix 适配器、注册渠道、安装依赖并运行测试，之后 Claude 就能在 Matrix 房间收发消息。
howto.when: 用户要求添加或接入 Matrix 聊天渠道时触发，通常在系统初始化或配置阶段。

say.text: 帮我把 Matrix 聊天渠道加进来。
say.note: Claude 会开始执行添加流程。

say.text: 配置一个 Matrix 机器人账号。
say.note: 会引导创建机器人并设置凭据。

say.text: 把 Matrix 接入到我的 agent 组。

howto.what_en: This skill adds Matrix chat channel support to Claude. It copies the Matrix adapter, registers the channel, installs dependencies, and runs tests, after which Claude can send and receive messages in Matrix rooms.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add or integrate a Matrix chat channel, typically during system setup or configuration.

say_en.text: Add the Matrix chat channel for me.
say_en.note: Claude will start the add flow.

say_en.text: Set up a Matrix bot account.
say_en.note: Guides you through creating a bot and setting credentials.

say_en.text: Connect Matrix to my agent group.
